results.text:
Electronics returns
Legacy FAQ wording says electronics, including the Bluetooth Speaker, can be returned within 30 days. This deliberately inconsistent FAQ passage is retained for conflict evaluation: return_policy v1 section window says 15 days. Both sources are applicable in the scenario and the discrepancy is unresolved. Do not use this FAQ to override policy; surface both references and escalate per escalation_guidelines section conflicts.

Window
Returns use calendar days from verified delivery, inclusive on the final day. The default return window is 30 days. Footwear and apparel have 30-day windows, home products have 30 days, and electronics have 15 days. An undelivered order has not started its return window. The earlier reported 60-day window is not current; use this version and disclose the discrepancy.

Shoes returns
For footwear return windows and inclusive date counting, see return_policy section window. Eligibility requires a verified order and configured rules.

Durations
Footwear and apparel carry a 90-day warranty, electronics 365 days, and home products 30 days. Perishable grocery products carry no warranty (0 days). Durations are configured in policy_rules.json. Do not convert a missing specification into a coverage promise.

results.summary: Conflict detected for electronics return window: FAQ states 30 days while return_policy states 15 days. Both sources retrieved; discrepancy is unresolved per FAQ guidance. Escalation required to determine authoritative rule.
